meta.description: Mirrors the sales list into leads + lead_stage_events. ClickUp stays the source of truth. n8n retries on clickup_task_id.

parameters.query:
insert into leads (created_at, source, campaign_id, creative_id, parent_name, clickup_task_id, is_qualified)
values ($1::timestamptz, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)
on conflict (clickup_task_id) do update set
  source = excluded.source,
  campaign_id = excluded.campaign_id,
  creative_id = excluded.creative_id,
  is_qualified = excluded.is_qualified
returning id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$json.id, $('Map to warehouse shape').item.json.stage, $('Map to warehouse shape').item.json.occurred_at] }}

parameters.query:
insert into clickup_sync_log (object_type, clickup_task_id, synced_at, status, detail)
values ('lead', $1, now(), 'ok', $2);

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Map to warehouse shape').item.json.clickup_task_id, $('Map to warehouse shape').item.json.stage] }}
